**Continuous 2.4.4**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.4.2 or 2.4.3, install the new `.vsix` the same way. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.4.4.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md).

| Platform                    | File                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.4.4.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.4.4.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.4.4.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.4.4.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.4.4.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.4.4.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.4.4-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## On the VS Code Marketplace

Continuous is on the VS Code Marketplace as **Continuous** (`b1tninja.continuous`), so VS Code can install and update it from the Extensions view. The Marketplace refused the earlier display name, "Continuous - open-source AI code agent", as too close to upstream's "Continue - open-source AI code agent"; the name is the only change to the package. The `.vsix` files below work as before.

## The CLI

The terminal agent is attached as `continuous-cli-2.4.4.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.4.4-vscode/continuous-cli-2.4.4.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous`. It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension.

## What's new since 2.4.3

- **Context budgets for the CLI, per model.** Three `contextManagement` settings in a model's `config.yaml` entry, each defaulting to the old behavior:
  - `autoCompactRatio` and `autoCompactTokens` set when a conversation is compacted: a fraction of the window left after the reply, and a cap in tokens. Before, the threshold kept a buffer of at most 15,000 tokens, so on a large window it compacted at about 97%.
  - `subagent.contextLength` (with its own `autoCompactRatio` and `autoCompactTokens`) gives sub-agents a smaller window, never above the model's own. A sub-agent's compacted history is no longer saved over the parent session.
  - `requestBodyHints.oneShot` and `requestBodyHints.conversation` add fields to the request body by request kind. For Strata, `strata_checkpoint: false` on the compaction summary keeps it from replacing the cached conversation.
- **No compaction loop.** When the system message and tools alone reached the threshold, the CLI compacted on every request. It now waits until the input no longer fits, and continues by itself after a compaction at most once in a row.

See `contextManagement` in the [reference](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/reference).

## Not included

The JetBrains plugin and the hosted Continue Hub are not part of Continuous. Hub `uses: owner/name` blocks are not supported; configure models and blocks directly or with local file paths.
